WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'),
fs AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) d FROM sem.claims c JOIN p USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT r.payer_class, COUNT(*) paid_claims,
 ROUND(MEDIAN(r.payment_date - fs.d),1) med, ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(r.payment_date - fs.d, 0.9),1) p90
FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN fs ON r.claim_key=fs.claim_key AND r.payer_key=fs.payer_key
WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code, COUNT(DISTINCT r.claim_key||'|'||r.payer_key) n
FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON a.remit_claim_id=r.remit_claim_id
WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

WITH pr AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, ANY_VALUE(payer_class) payer_class, COUNT(*) n,
  BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) pairs, SUM(CASE WHEN n=1 AND ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) resolved,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN n=1 AND ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) rate FROM pr GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pr AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, ANY_VALUE(payer_class) payer_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) nt, BOOL_OR(is_reversal) rev, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) cur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_current_adjudication THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) pairs, SUM(CASE WHEN rev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_rev,
 SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cur THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_current, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(paid),0),2) paid
FROM pr WHERE nt>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', service_date_from) m, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_date_from>=DATE '2026-06-01'),
t AS (SELECT m, COUNT(*) tot FROM c GROUP BY 1),
rk AS (SELECT m, referring_npi, COUNT(*) n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, referring_npi) rn FROM c WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT strftime(t.m,'%Y-%m') month, t.tot, SUM(rk.n) top5, ROUND(100.0*SUM(rk.n)/t.tot,1) share
FROM t JOIN rk ON t.m=rk.m AND rk.rn<=5 GROUP BY t.m, t.tot ORDER BY t.m

WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l.line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE CAST(l.line_count AS VARCHAR) END b, r.is_denied, l.charge_amount
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P') p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
 JOIN l ON l.claim_key=p.claim_key)
SELECT b, COUNT(*) claims, SUM(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) denied,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) rate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_denied THEN charge_amount END),0) denied_charge
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fb AS (SELECT * FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB')
SELECT a.reference_id, a.payment_date, ROUND(-a.provider_adjustment_amount,2) amt,
 MIN(b.payment_date) offset_date, MIN(b.payment_date)-a.payment_date days
FROM fb a LEFT JOIN fb b ON b.payer_key=a.payer_key AND b.reference_id=a.reference_id
 AND b.provider_adjustment_amount=-a.provider_adjustment_amount AND b.payment_date>a.payment_date
WHERE a.provider_adjustment_amount<0 GROUP BY a.provider_adjustment_id, a.reference_id, a.payment_date, a.provider_adjustment_amount
ORDER BY a.payment_date, a.reference_id

WITH m AS (SELECT payer_class, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_month=DATE '2026-07-01' THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) j,
 SUM(CASE WHEN payment_month=DATE '2026-08-01' THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) a FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT payer_class, 100.0*j/SUM(j) OVER () sj, 100.0*a/SUM(a) OVER () sa FROM m)
SELECT payer_class, ROUND(sj,1), ROUND(sa,1), ROUND(sa-sj,1) FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' AND payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
orig AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) od FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='1' GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT rep.*, orig.od, r.payment_date pd, r.paid_amount FROM rep LEFT JOIN orig USING(claim_key,payer_key)
 LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=rep.claim_key AND r.payer_key=rep.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.payment_date>=rep.rd)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT claim_key) n, ROUND(AVG(rd-od),2) avg_rework, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pd IS NOT NULL THEN claim_key END) paid_after,
 ROUND(AVG(pd-od),2) avg_to_pay, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount),0) total_paid FROM x

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key, MIN(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT v.claim_key, BOOL_OR(rc.paid_amount>0 AND rc.payment_date<v.vd) pb, BOOL_OR(rc.is_reversal AND rc.payment_date>=v.vd) rv, SUM(rc.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication) cp FROM v LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims rc USING(claim_key) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(pb::INT),0), COALESCE(SUM(rv::INT),0), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cp),0),2) FROM r

WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'),
fs AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) d FROM sem.claims c JOIN p USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1,2),
co AS (SELECT fs.*, pc.payer_class FROM fs JOIN sem.payers pc USING(payer_key) WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'),
fr AS (SELECT co.claim_key, co.payer_class, co.d, MIN(r.payment_date) fp FROM co LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=co.claim_key AND r.payer_key=co.payer_key GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN fp-d<=14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w14, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fp-d<=14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) pct
FROM fr GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
e AS (SELECT rep.* FROM rep WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=rep.claim_key AND r.payer_key=rep.payer_key AND r.is_denied_recorded AND r.payment_date<rep.rd)),
o AS (SELECT e.claim_key, e.payer_key,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=e.claim_key AND r.payer_key=e.payer_key AND r.payment_date>=e.rd) since,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(is_denied) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=e.claim_key AND r.payer_key=e.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) cd,
  (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=e.claim_key AND r.payer_key=e.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) paid FROM e)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT since THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cd IS NOT NULL AND NOT cd THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END outcome,
 COUNT(*) n, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(paid),0),2) paid FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied)
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount),0) FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims o WHERE o.claim_key=c.claim_key AND o.payer_key=c.payer_key AND NOT o.is_current_adjudication AND NOT o.is_reversal AND o.is_denied AND o.payment_date<=c.payment_date AND o.remit_claim_id<>c.remit_claim_id)

WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, charge_amount, frequency_code FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'),
fs AS (SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, MIN(c.submission_date) d FROM sem.claims c JOIN p USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1,2),
o AS (SELECT fs.claim_key, DATE '2026-08-14'-fs.d age, l.charge_amount FROM fs JOIN l USING(claim_key)
 WHERE COALESCE(l.frequency_code,'')<>'8' AND fs.d<=DATE '2026-08-14' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=fs.claim_key AND r.payer_key=fs.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication))
SELECT CASE WHEN age<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END b, COUNT(DISTINCT claim_key) n, SUM(charge_amount) chg FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(age)

WITH l AS (SELECT payer_key, payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount a FROM sem.remit_lines
 WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND units_paid=1 AND line_allowed_amount>0),
f AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, a, COUNT(*) n FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3),
t AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, a typ FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, a DESC) rn FROM f) WHERE rn=1)
SELECT l.payer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN l.a<t.typ THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.a<t.typ THEN t.typ-l.a END),0),2) shortfall
FROM l JOIN t USING(payer_key, procedure_code) GROUP BY l.payer_key, l.payer_name ORDER BY shortfall DESC, l.payer_name

SELECT payer_class, strftime(m,'%Y-%m') month, n, d, ROUND(100.0*d/n,2) rate, ROUND(100.0*d/n - LAG(100.0*d/n) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY m),2) chg FROM m ORDER BY 1, m

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, ANY_VALUE(referring_npi ORDER BY submission_date DESC) npi FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT p.npi, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_denied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) rate FROM p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
WHERE p.npi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>=15 ORDER BY rate DESC, 1 LIMIT 5
